passages.provision_quote: SB 1294 requires the Arizona Department of Administration to lease the currently vacant Marana Prison to the U.S. government for $1 per year.
passages.note: Leases a detention facility to the federal government; shows enforcement-side support but does not state which undocumented immigrants should be removed (annex 'Enforcement funding').
passages.actor_quote: All three measures, sponsored by Senator John Kavanagh, passed the Senate and are being transmitted to the House of Representatives for consideration.

passages.provision_quote: SB 1299 establishes the Law Enforcement Personnel Grant Program to reimburse law enforcement agencies for immigration training costs.
passages.note: Funds officer immigration-enforcement training; enforcement-side funding only, no removal criterion stated (annex 'Enforcement funding').
passages.actor_quote: All three measures, sponsored by Senator John Kavanagh, passed the Senate and are being transmitted to the House of Representatives for consideration.

passages.provision_quote: SB 1610 requires county detention facilities to provide personal identifying information and access to an arrested person, on the request of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
passages.note: Requires local-federal information sharing with ICE; annex treats cooperation-with-enforcement bills as adjacent to the removal-scope question.
passages.actor_quote: All three measures, sponsored by Senator John Kavanagh, passed the Senate and are being transmitted to the House of Representatives for consideration.

rows.reasoning: Kavanagh sponsored SB 1294 (leasing Marana Prison to the federal government for detention), SB 1299 (immigration-enforcement training grants), and SB 1610 (requiring county jails to share arrestee information with ICE), all of which passed the Senate. SB 1294 and SB 1299 show enforcement-side support (detention capacity, officer training) without stating which undocumented immigrants should be removed, so they are direction-only. SB 1610 requires state-federal cooperation, which the annex treats as adjacent to the removal-scope question rather than the rule itself. No passage states a removal criterion matching any rung's clauses (entire removal, convicted-violent-only, recent arrivals, or a mass-deportation programme), so the row is BLANK direction-only.

quotes.text: The federal government should have access to the empty Marana Prison to house these dangerous criminal illegal aliens so that Arizonans are protected from further threats
With this bill, we are supporting the federal government's deportation efforts by requiring detention facilities to supply inmate information to ICE.
With additional training, we can ensure that our front-line officers are equipped for the job, protecting both themselves, and the people of this great state.
